The main takeaway from our work is that

RNA interference is an effective method of regulating gene expression in hEC and h ES cells, which can be used to investigate the function of specific genes during the differentiation of these cells, as well as in their maintenance in the undifferentiated state.
RNAi can be used to specifically regulate gene expression in hEC and hESC cells, and that Oct4 knockdown in these cells induces differentiation to a trophectodermal lineage.
